note: Adapted from the English original of Bourguignon et al. (2008); the original gives only the diagnostic characters and the measurements of the queen and soldier for this species (TABLE 3, 1 queen; TABLE 4, 12 soldiers), with no descriptions of the alate or worker; for morphological detail the original refers to Miller (1991). Locality records, specimens examined and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Body distinctly smaller than in the other species of the genus (TABLE 3–4, 18; worker head width 0.632–0.702 mm), and the soldier postmentum projects markedly downwards, by which it can be recognized. In the soldier key it is the counterpart of E. cheeli: the soldier of this species is very small, head width < 0.75 mm and left mandible length < 1.4 mm (TABLE 4), with the postmentum projecting downwards, whereas the soldier of E. cheeli is medium-sized (head width > 0.8 mm) with the postmentum not projecting. In New Guinean specimens the frontal projection is upturned, slightly different from Australian specimens, but not enough to regard them as a distinct species.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body small; postmentum projecting markedly downwards; frontal projection well developed, upturned in New Guinean specimens. Measurements (TABLE 4, 12 individuals from 2 nests): head length to tip of frontal projection 0.99–1.12 mm; head length to anterolateral corner of gena 0.91–1.02 mm; head depth including postmentum 0.45–0.57 mm; head depth excluding postmentum 0.57–0.71 mm; maximum head width 0.60–0.72 mm; pronotal width 0.38–0.46 mm; left mandible length 1.24–1.33 mm; minimum postmentum width 0.14–0.21 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Queen (TABLE 3, 1 individual): body length without wings 10.58 mm; head length to apex of labrum 0.87 mm; head length to frontoclypeal suture 0.50 mm; head width including compound eyes 0.74 mm; maximum diameter of compound eye 0.20 mm; maximum length of ocellus 0.10 mm; pronotal length 0.45 mm; pronotal width 0.70 mm.
